title: Periodic inspection and category testing repair.
officialText: All defects as found in periodic inspection and category testing reports shall be corrected in accordance with the requirements of sections 28-304.6.6.1 and 28-304.6.6.2 of this code, except that all hazardous conditions and defects related to firefighters’ Phase I emergency recall operations or Phase II emergency in-car operation as required by section 3003.2 of the New York city building code shall be corrected immediately.
